steps.en: The latest mobile number of the individual owner is obtained
steps.id: Nomor HP terbaru pemilik individu didapat
steps.why_en: The latest-contact lookup is switched off, so only stored contacts are used.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan kontak terbaru dimatikan, jadi hanya kontak tersimpan yang dipakai.

steps.en: Unique individual owners are identified and their open notices combined
steps.id: Pemilik individu unik diidentifikasi dan notice terbukanya digabung
steps.why_en: Notices with different due dates still produce separate messages for the same owner.
steps.why_id: Notice dengan tanggal jatuh tempo berbeda tetap jadi pesan terpisah untuk pemilik yang sama.

steps.en: Opted-out, passport or no-mobile owners get no SMS
steps.id: Pemilik opt-out, ber-paspor, atau tanpa nomor HP tidak dikirimi SMS

steps.en: The SMS lists the open notices and refers to the 2nd letter
steps.id: SMS memuat notice yang masih terbuka dan merujuk surat kedua
steps.why_en: The message wording is held outside the code, so it cannot be confirmed here.
steps.why_id: Isi pesan disimpan di luar code, jadi tidak bisa dipastikan di sini.

steps.en: The SMS is sent to the owner in a batch job
steps.id: SMS dikirim ke pemilik lewat batch job
steps.why_en: The reminder job and SMS sending are both switched off in production.
steps.why_id: Job reminder dan pengiriman SMS sama-sama dimatikan di produksi.
